summary: Teaches enabling and using Grafana Assistant, including prompts, @ mentions of data sources and Learn mode.

needs.description: grafana-assistant-app installed and available to enable from plugin settings (path has enable step) with LLM/Assistant entitlement
Admin role to enable Assistant in plugin settings
At least one Prometheus or Loki data source selectable via @ mention (e.g. grafanacloud-usage exists on Cloud)

reviewNotes: Assistant responses are LLM-generated and nondeterministic.
